notes.title: Hotfix - Hospital section
notes.content:
We are aware you faced an issue with an item in hospital section, we fixed it in the current hotfix. We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

Thanks for the comprehension

notes.title: Clues Update + Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello! 

We are aware that some of the puzzles are a bit confusing, so we updated some clues in order to get a better understanding of how to solve them. 

We also patched some issues during saving / loading the game in some areas that affected to some puzzles. 

Thanks for the comprehension!
